description: Substantive published changes. Dates describe the linked content change, not an automatic build or a stock check.

Added primary manufacturer references and separated mesh-backhaul testing from client performance with a repeatable placement record.
Added manufacturer placement evidence and a repeatable location comparison that separates ISP speed from Wi-Fi diagnosis.
Replaced vague volume advice with attributed AAP exposure guidance and explained why a volume percentage cannot establish a safe sound level.
Added CDC cleaning and sanitizing conditions, higher-risk infant criteria and the applicable dishwasher alternative.
Corrected towel-drying advice and specified CDC rack-cleaning and protected-storage conditions.
Added veterinary litter-box care evidence and separated particle filtration from gas/odor removal using EPA guidance.
Added a named manufacturer manual example, indoor-use and electrical limits, and an alarm plan that preserves fire protection.
Added an interactive and printable worksheet for operating footprint, shelf-specific load and scanner-lid clearance, with an explicitly illustrative worked example.
Added an interactive and printable seat-depth worksheet, a worked subtraction example and repeatable checks for the actual chair and cushion.
Expanded to eight Tiny models, including a separate M70q Gen 2 reference, with generation-specific memory and unresolved-parts boundaries.
Added cable-and-carrier checks, existing-parts checks and the conditions for avoiding a duplicate kit purchase.
Clarified machine-type parts evidence and the conflict between a PCIe card and a 2.5-inch drive.
Separated two-NVMe storage options from configuration-specific PCIe and SATA fit.
Added complete cable paths, Mac display limits, DisplayLink requirements and missing-parts checks.
Added actual clamp geometry, minimum monitor weight, reinforcement thickness and unknown-fit outcomes.
Separated local NAS, routed, direct and internet paths, with complete port budgets and link-rate ceilings.
Clarified exact pack choices, the WAN/backhaul path and verified buying options.
Added the TS4-versus-newer-dock decision and the limits that a new dock cannot remove.
Paused an unavailable exact listing and distinguished the Original model from a different recalled folding model.
Added a three-generation comparison with keep-or-upgrade decisions, charging, network and cable-path checks.
Added the Link 2 and Pro comparison, including fixed versus motorized framing and computer software limitations.
Added platform-specific feature checks and the differences between a native integration and a Matter bridge.
Added a complete-chain outage plan that separates ISP loss, local-network failure and loss of mains power.
Added exact-generation no-drill mount checks, surface limitations and a reversible installation plan.
Added a two-option ownership calculator with separate first-year and renewal subscriptions, consumables and electricity.
Added moving-knee clearance, chair stability and powered-versus-manual checks without transferring another brand's measurements.
Separated model-specific and grip-style adapters, combined load and unresolved exact-monitor fit.
Identified the RR-60 as a single-sheet scanner and added exact paper-handling and export checks.
Added camera placement, reflection, clamp and power checks, keeping different manufacturers' specifications separate.

Separated moving/fixed cable paths and model-specific travel, mounting and service-access conditions.
Separated peripheral, display and two-host switching roles; current UGREEN 15705 documentation is not transferred to 30768.
Added privacy, shared seating, wired Speak2 40 variant boundaries and current Teams device-selection checks.
Distinguished Wi-Fi 6E from 7, with client/region/software, backhaul and complete wired-path upgrade conditions.
Added complete-channel and construction checks, keep-existing outcomes and removed the automatic switch purchase fallback.
Added upstream port counting, exact hardware-revision chains and separate management, PoE and link-rate decisions.
Separated USB, Ethernet, OS, display and power paths and removed an unrelated switch as the adapter buying route.
Replaced home-mesh references with a travel-router reference, current portal limitations and documented Beryl 7 comparison.
Added provider/coax/security/node-count conditions from current linked documents and separated MoCA from endpoint PoE.
Replaced non-PoE purchase references with a conditional PoE model and separated power standards, allocation, port count and data rates.
